Терминов {0}, замен {1}. Термин - как пи.en: Terms {0}, replacements {1}. A term is how a word is written: so the clouds hear it (xAI, ElevenLabs, OpenAI after the stop), so the text modes, the meeting minutes and the transcription of files write it. A replacement is made in the text of every dictation, GigaAM's too, which cannot be told words. The file config\dictionary.txt.

Где GigaAM режет длинную запись на куски.en: Where GigaAM cuts a long recording into pieces of 12-25 seconds: SILERO VAD - in the pauses of speech, BY TIME - at the quietest moment of the window. No sound is thrown away either way: quiet speech reaches the model too.

GigaAM v3 RNN-T на этой машине (ONNX Run.en: GigaAM v3 RNN-T on this machine (ONNX Runtime: the video card or the processor) - Russian speech.

Whisper large-v3-turbo на whisper.cpp, н.en: Whisper large-v3-turbo on whisper.cpp, on the processor - English and mixed speech.

Whisper large-v2 на whisper.cpp, на виде.en: Whisper large-v2 on whisper.cpp, on the NVIDIA card (CUDA) - English and mixed speech.

Whisper large-v2 на whisper.cpp - точнее.en: Whisper large-v2 on whisper.cpp - more accurate on hard recordings, but many times heavier.

Расшифровка сервисом по его ключу: OpenA.en: Transcription by a service with its key: OpenAI, xAI, Gemini, AssemblyAI, GigaChat. The recording goes over the network.

Community-1, где он установлен; иначе So.en: Community-1 where it is installed; Sortformer otherwise.

pyannote Community-1: точнее, нужен ключ.en: pyannote Community-1: more accurate, needs the Hugging Face key; on the NVIDIA card or on the processor.

Диктовка и запись берут микрофон, выбран.en: Dictation and recording take the microphone chosen on DICTATIONS or in the tray; DEFAULT is the one chosen in the sound settings of Windows.

Движок, модели, обработка текста, микроф.en: The engine, the models, the text mode, the microphone and the floating panel are on DICTATIONS, the transcription of recordings on RECORDINGS and FILES, the dictionary on DICTIONARY. Here is what is set once.

с локальной моделью - только при ключе O.en: with the local model - only with an OpenAI or xAI key
